title: Premier Loyalty Rate on a Move Up to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** A Premier loyalty rate is a percentage reduction of the upgrade charge when a Tailwise Plus Annual member moves up to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual. It rests on the membership fee charges on the rewards history dated in the last 36 months and the full calendar months the membership has been enrolled.

**Rule.** A membership with at least 3 membership fees charged in the last 36 months and enrolled for at least 60 months: 10% (0.1). A membership that does not meet both of those conditions but has at least 2 such fees and is enrolled for at least 24 months: 5% (0.05). Any other membership: no Premier loyalty rate.

| Fees charged in the last 36 months | Months enrolled | Premier loyalty rate |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | 60 or more | 10% |
| 3 or more | 24 to 59 | 5% |
| exactly 2 | 24 or more | 5% |
| 0 or 1 | any | none |
| any | fewer than 24 | none |

**Example (hypothetical).** Two fees in 36 months, enrolled 66 months: 5% — the months meet the higher line but the fee count does not.
